tasks.short: Design instrumentation for studying plant and animal life

steps.what: Establish plant or animal measurement requirements and verify operating conditions
Design sensing, measuring and recording devices suited to the biological study
Repeat specified range, resolution and sampling calculations across selected components
Check biological suitability, calculation results and complete the actual design specification

tasks.design: Test native engineering calculation tables in {OTHER} before adding a small repeat-run routine. Repeat only the engineer's specified component comparisons; retain requirements, sensor design and complete verification and specification writing in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated numerical comparisons sit alongside biological and instrumentation judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed formulas can evaluate explicit component parameters without choosing the measurement method.
tasks.still_hard: Avoiding sensor disturbance and obtaining meaningful biological measurements.
tasks.human_edge: Choose suitable sensing principles and validate the design in its biological context.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated calculation entry with unchanged design responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: engineering calculation tools can repeat fixed range, resolution and sampling calculations from verified specifications; they do not establish biological suitability.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is instrumentation design through its actual specification, without procurement, controller deployment or an external release. OTHER is an engineering calculation and design application.

The engineer verifies component ID, range, resolution, sample interval, units and operating conditions in s1-s2. Component datasheets are produced by suppliers, but extraction and verification are retained; missing fields stop for manual completion.

The 20 points are repeated manual calculation interactions, not existing solver runtime. Native tables are tested first. s4 retains independent checks, failed-input repair, substantive specification writing and ordinary save. Repair beyond its allowance lowers the estimate.
No new activity report or device-control operation is created; same-system design saves are fully retained and ungated.
research_questions: Replay a real sensor design and count manual entry, unit repair and independent verification.

incremental.description: Maintain calculation rules and component-unit tests

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 20 repeat-calculation points less 1.5 upkeep. New biological sensing needs incompatible component parameters; retain bespoke calculations and repeat only 4 points of compatible range checks: 4 minus 1.5 = 2.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify agricultural machinery loads, interfaces and operating requirements
Design agricultural machinery components and equipment in the CAD application
Create repeat drawing views and dimension fields from the selected geometry
Verify complete machinery drawings, tolerances, interfaces and required design notes

tasks.design: Configure native associative drawing views and dimension styles in the CAD application in {OTHER}. They replace repeated view placement and field entry after the engineer creates the geometry; the engineer retains tolerance decisions, complete checks and design notes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated drawing construction consumes time after component geometry has been designed.
tasks.enabler_now: Native associative views can reuse geometry and selected drawing conventions.
tasks.still_hard: Designing reliable machinery for variable loads and agricultural conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Judge load paths, interfaces, manufacturability and safe operation.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive drawing construction with unchanged machinery design authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: parametric CAD applications can generate associative views and dimension fields from selected geometry; tolerances and design correctness still require engineering review.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a workflow with manual repeat drawing construction. OTHER is the CAD application. Existing automated drawing runtime has no labour-saving baseline.

The engineer creates and checks part IDs, model revision, geometry, units, selected views and dimension conventions in s1-s2. Missing geometry or legacy conversion is manually repaired there or in s4; it is not a free structured input.

Native views and styles are tested first. The 25 points are the specific repeated placement and field-entry operations removed. s4 retains full inspection, bespoke dimensions, repair, design notes and ordinary save. Excess conversion repair requires a lower estimate.
The task ends at the checked design, without a manufacturing release or cutter send. No gate is placed on an ordinary author save.
unknowns: Legacy model compatibility and repair effort
research_questions: Generate views for a real agricultural assembly and count omitted dimensions and conversion repair.

incremental.description: Maintain drawing styles and regression examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 25 repeat drawing points less 1.5 upkeep. A legacy imported assembly requires manual reconstruction of most views; reuse only 5 points of compatible view and label placement: 5 minus 1.5 = 3.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design and supervise agricultural land reclamation projects

steps.what: Inspect site conditions and verify land, drainage and environmental inputs
Design agricultural environmental and land reclamation measures
Repeat specified land-area and earthwork quantity calculations on verified layers
Verify quantities, environmental implications and complete the actual reclamation plan
Supervise environmental and land reclamation work on site

tasks.design: Test native area and earthwork functions in the geographic design application in {OTHER}. Repeat the engineer's selected calculations on checked layers, retaining site inspection, reclamation design, full plan checks in {DOCS} and physical supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated quantity calculations are mixed with site-specific environmental design.
tasks.enabler_now: Native geographic functions can reuse explicit layer and calculation settings.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing drainage, soil stability and ecological consequences in changing field conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Make and revise reclamation decisions based on the actual land and work.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated quantity assembly, with unchanged field responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: geographic design tools calculate areas and quantities from compatible selected layers; environmental suitability and field supervision remain professional work.

assumptions: Provisional boundary covers design and actual supervision, not permit submission or contractor procurement. OTHER is the geographic design application.

Survey owners produce layers, but the engineer verifies coordinate system, datum, units, extent, survey date and validity in s1-s2. Missing or incompatible layers require counted manual repair. No free new survey or normalized dataset is assumed.

Only 15 repeated calculation-entry and table-assembly points are removed. Native functions are assessed first; existing runtime earns no credit. s4 retains independent checks, manual exceptions, substantive plan writing and ordinary save; greater repair volume lowers the estimate.
No new supervision diary is imposed. Any actual defect report or formal project release would need separate counted work and its own action boundary.
unknowns: Layer compatibility and actual repeat calculation share
research_questions: Run quantity functions on one real reclamation design and count layer repair separately.

incremental.description: Maintain layer checks and quantity-rule examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 15 repeat-calculation points less 1.5 upkeep. Mixed survey datums and irregular terrain leave only 3 points of compatible parcel-area calculations reusable: 3 minus 1.5 = 1.5; other quantity work stays manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design food processing plants and mechanical systems

steps.what: Verify food-process requirements, equipment interfaces and operating constraints
Design the food processing plant layout and related mechanical systems
Repeat explicit geometry clashes and selected maintenance-clearance comparisons
Verify food safety, maintainability and design results and complete specifications

tasks.design: Configure native clash and explicit clearance checks in the plant-design application in {OTHER}. They remove repeated geometry comparisons; the engineer retains process design, hygienic suitability, exception resolution and complete specifications in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual comparisons of equipment and pipe geometry repeat after design changes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native rule checks can test explicit geometry and clearance distances without judging process safety.
tasks.still_hard: Designing hygienic, maintainable systems that fit actual production requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Judge food-process hazards and distinguish meaningful problems from geometric flags.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated geometry checking, with unchanged plant design responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: plant-design and model-checking tools can identify explicit geometric clashes and clearance violations; this does not establish hygienic or process safety.

assumptions: Shares describe a provisional manual-comparison workflow, not a vendor speed claim. OTHER is the plant-design and model-checking application; the task ends before construction release or equipment deployment.

The engineer verifies model revision, component ID, geometry, units, clearance rule and equipment envelope in s1-s2. Supplier specifications are not assumed machine-ready: extraction, missing envelope repair and failed conversion remain counted there and in s4.

Native checks are tested first. Only the 25 repeated comparison points are removed; existing automatic checks earn no credit. s4 retains false-flag review, incomplete-model repair, substantive specifications and ordinary save. Repair beyond the allowance requires a lower estimate.
No model certifies food safety and no gate is added to an ordinary design save.
unknowns: Model completeness and existing clash automation
research_questions: Check a real plant model with incomplete supplier geometry and measure correction time.

incremental.description: Maintain geometry rules and compatibility regression checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 25 repeated comparison points less 2 upkeep. Legacy equipment lacks usable envelopes, so retain those manual comparisons and automate only 5 points of compatible pipe and room geometry checks: 5 minus 2 = 3.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain biological, mechanical and environmental design decisions while reducing specified repeat calculations and geometry operations.
role.ambitious_version: No additional design authority or service is justified by these estimates.
